process.instruction: Resolve BSD-bound Fields from _bmf_comp_ai_ and retrieve their canonical Stems from field2stem_generated_all.json.
Assign each resolved Stem a BSD-conditioned lecturability weight according to _stem2syllabi_wgt_.
Preserve source Field and Stem identities and validate all generated weights against _stem2syllabi_wgt_.
Materialize the weighted Stem state without modifying its source states.
